healing_draught.name: Healing Draught
healing_draught.description: A stoppered vial of something red and bitter. Restores 35 health.
healing_draught.use_text: You drink the draught. Warmth spreads through your chest.

greater_draught.name: Greater Draught
greater_draught.description: A heavy flask that glows faintly. Restores 70 health.
greater_draught.use_text: You drain the flask. Your wounds close as you watch.

firebomb.name: Firebomb
firebomb.description: A clay pot of pitch with a rag fuse. Throw it in a fight: 28 damage and the target burns.

combat.text: You light the fuse and throw. The pot bursts in a sheet of fire.

antidote.name: Antidote
antidote.description: Chalky and foul. In a fight it clears poison, burning and bleeding.
antidote.use_text: You are not poisoned at the moment.

focus_incense.name: Focus Incense
focus_incense.description: A twist of bitter herbs. Burned in a fight it grants 3 focus at once.

combat.text: You breathe the smoke. The world slows and sharpens.

focus_incense.use_text: It only helps in the heat of a fight.

whetstone.name: Whetstone
whetstone.description: A fine-grained stone. Use it to put a lasting edge on your weapon (attack +1).

on_use.text: You work the stone along the edge until it sings.

iron_tonic.name: Iron Tonic
iron_tonic.description: Tastes of nails. Drink it to toughen your hide for good (defense +1).

on_use.text: You swallow the tonic. Your skin prickles and hardens.

heart_root.name: Heart Root
heart_root.description: A knotted root that beats, faintly, in your hand. Eat it to raise your maximum health by 15.

on_use.text: You chew the root. It is like eating a drum.

thieves_tools.name: Thieves' Tools
thieves_tools.description: Picks, rakes and a tension bar in an oiled roll. Any locked chest is merely a slow chest.

skeleton_key.name: Skeleton Key
skeleton_key.description: A key carved from a finger bone. It fits every lock down here, which says something about the locksmith.

twin_daggers.name: Twin Daggers
twin_daggers.description: A matched pair. Fast, and they find gaps.

ash_staff.name: Ash Staff
ash_staff.description: A charred staff, still warm at the tip.

steel_blade.name: Steel Blade
steel_blade.description: Good steel with a keen edge. Somebody loved this once.

emberbrand.name: Emberbrand
emberbrand.description: A blade with a line of fire sleeping in the fuller.

tower_shield.name: Tower Shield
tower_shield.description: A door with a handle. It stops most arguments.

leather_jerkin.name: Leather Jerkin
leather_jerkin.description: Boiled leather, stiff as a board.

chain_shirt.name: Chain Shirt
chain_shirt.description: Rings on rings on rings. Heavy; worth it.

warden_plate.name: Warden's Plate
warden_plate.description: Blackened plate from an older war.

lucky_coin.name: Lucky Coin
lucky_coin.description: Both sides are heads. Wear it for luck (critical hits +10%).

grave_charm.name: Grave Charm
grave_charm.description: A knot of hair and wire that hums against your chest (maximum health +20).

chest.name: Chest
chest.lock_text: The chest is locked. You would need a key - or a set of picks.

shrine.name: Shrine
shrine.description: A small stone shrine with a single candle that has no business still burning.

pray.text: You kneel. The flame flares gold, and warmth pours through you. Then the candle gutters out.

use.text: You hold your hands to the flame. It flares gold, and warmth pours through you. Then the candle gutters out.

spent.description: The candle has burned out. The stone is still warm.

actions.pray: You kneel, but the shrine has given all it had.
actions.use: The shrine has given all it had.

ember_crown.name: Ember Crown
ember_crown.description: A circlet of dark iron set with coals that have never gone out.
